name: LightMemo
description: Production RiverMemo V5 with native warped Chunk recall and warped Tag observation; warped ANN fallback. Legacy TDB ANN and RiverMemo V3/4 load only for the six-track AB laboratory. Optional external Rerank/Jev.
author: VCP

EXCLUDED_FOLDERS.description: 需要屏蔽、任何时候都不搜索的日记文件夹名称，用逗号分隔。

RerankUrl.description: Rerank服务的URL，如果需要使用Rerank功能则必须提供。

RerankMaxDocumentsPerRequest.description: 单次Rerank请求的最大候选数，代码硬上限为25。

RerankMaxConcurrentRequests.description: Rerank小批量请求的最大并发数，限制范围为1到10。

JevRerankPrompt.default: 请选择最值得用于回答当前查询的记忆。请综合考虑逻辑关联、记忆叙事连续性与信息解释力；优先选择能直接回答问题、补足关键背景或维持事件连续性的内容，压低表面词汇重合、重复、跑题或缺乏上下文价值的内容。

JevRerankMaxChoices.description: LightMemo单次Jev精排最大候选数，硬上限255；普通搜索受2倍K窗口限制，AB使用两套召回的完整有界去重并集。

JevRerankMaxDocumentChars.description: 每篇候选发送给Jev的最大字符数。

invocationCommands.description: Search diary memory with enginemode=rivermemo (default: native warped RiverMemo V5 with warped ANN fallback) or knn (pure warped Chunk ANN). Retired TagMemo modes are rejected. query required; maid/folder or search_all_knowledge_bases defines scope. k defaults to 5. Date constraints are preserved. BM25 applies only to RiverMemo; KNN uses global warped geometry without Tag sensing; scores are negative exact warped distances, not probabilities. Legacy TDB ANN and RiverMemo V3/4 are AB-only. Numeric tag_boost and core_tags/core_boost_factor configure shared RiverMemo sensing; + suffix is retired. Optional rerank/jev consume at most 2*K; jev wins if both enabled. aimemo/aimemo_preset summarize final candidates. TDB knowledge_base routing remains independent.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」LightMemo「末」,
enginemode:「始」rivermemo「末」,
folder:「始」VCP开发「末」,
query:「始」RiverMemo如何恢复连续记忆中的逻辑链「末」,
k:「始」5「末」,
tag_boost:「始」0.6「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description: command=memory_ab runs six tracks: native TDB-SM recall with original cosine ranking; external Rerank; Jev; existing RiverMemo V3/4 on TDB candidates; global warped Chunk ANN ranked by negative exact warped distance; production warped RiverMemo V5 on warped Chunk candidates with warped Tag observation. Both RiverMemo tracks use the same existing native readout algorithm to rescore, not the ANN order; V5 denotes the pipeline, not a new readout algorithm. Chunk recall and readout share one SQL snapshot and scope; Tag observations are prepared separately with the same artifact signature, not one globally atomic snapshot. query and explicit scope required. k defaults to 5 (maximum 100); candidate_k defaults to 30 per retriever (maximum 100, at least k). compare_rerank/compare_jev (aliases compareRerank/compareJev) default true. External tracks use the deduplicated union, at most 200 candidates, subject to JevRerankMaxChoices. This is end-to-end comparison, not fixed-pool ablation or measured exact recall. Small scopes use exact warped scoring over shared geometry. First warped query may build/persist a global derived sidecar, while daily writes synchronize live membership without rebuilding frozen geometry; existing Tag-threshold or explicit full training replaces geometry. Tag initialization fallback makes V5 unavailable; invalid assets or vector/I/O errors explicitly fail rather than impersonate warped results. Ordinary search defaults to V5 with warped ANN fallback; this explicit laboratory is the only caller that loads legacy TDB/V3/4 recall tracks. BM25 is candidate-local evidence, not global lexical recall.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」LightMemo「末」,
command:「始」memory_ab「末」,
folder:「始」VCP开发「末」,
query:「始」RiverMemo如何恢复连续记忆中的逻辑链「末」,
k:「始」8「末」,
candidate_k:「始」30「末」,
compare_rerank:「始」true「末」,
compare_jev:「始」true「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
